Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-verification-flag-code

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-verification-flag-code defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
timing_gap Client Presence Timing GapFactual session or client-presence timing gap. Distinct from timing-gap in the supervision reconciliation outcome system.
authorization_period_mismatch Authorization period mismatchThe session timing does not match the authorization period on file; this fact is not a coverage decision.
authorization_not_on_file Authorization not on fileNo authorization is on file for the context being checked; this fact is not a coverage decision.
identity_mismatch Identity mismatchThe provider identity at session End did not match the provider identity at Start (PROV-002). This code applies only to provider identity, not client identity.
location_out_of_bounds Location out of boundsThe observed location is outside the applicable configured bounds; this terminology does not define a distance threshold.
device_attestation_failed Device attestation failedThe device attestation failed or a tamper condition was reported. The separate attestation/tamper code and detail sub-code contract remains pending.
clock_skew Clock skewThe source clock is not synchronized within the applicable clock rule; this terminology does not define a time tolerance.
consent_missing Required consent evidence missing at StartRequired consent evidence was genuinely absent at first Start. This excludes expired, declined, withdrawn, rejected, pending-scan, superseded, insufficient-authority, conflicting or otherwise nonqualifying evidence. A backend state or reason label alone is insufficient; ambiguous evidence must not be assigned this code. This code alone does not establish a capture restriction or payer disposition.
consent_withdrawn Consent withdrawn before StartConsent withdrawal was already effective at first Start, supported by the session's immutable Start facts. This does not describe withdrawal after Start or an immediate running-session cutoff. No later-withdrawal report finding is approved. This code alone does not establish a capture restriction or payer disposition.
